cluster.description: Cluster name, exactly as returned by list_clusters.

end.description: Range end, same forms as start. Defaults to now.

format.description: Output encoding. compact is columnar and is what you want; json is the raw Prometheus shape and costs ten to fifty times more tokens.

maxPoints.description: Maximum samples per series. Drives automatic step selection.

maxSeries.description: Maximum series to return. Series are ranked by their maximum value; the selection strategy is named in truncated.selection.

query.description: PromQL expression to evaluate over the range, e.g. rate(http_requests_total[5m]).

start.description: Range start. Relative ("now-6h", "-15m") or RFC 3339 or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to now-1h.

step.description: Resolution, e.g. "1m". Omit to let the hub choose: it snaps to {15s,30s,1m,5m,15m,1h,6h,1d}, never goes below the cluster's scrape interval, and always reports what it applied in downsampled.
